attractions.notes_base: Highest peak in the Vosges at 1,424m. Loop trail from parking at Vieil Armand / Hartmannswillerkopf area. 8.89km, 470m elevation gain, ~3h21 hiking time, Moderate difficulty. Park at Parking du Grand Ballon (47.9046, 7.1030) near the radar station / hotel. Trail is marked GR5. In early May, summit can have residual snow patches and strong winds — bring warm layers and windbreaker. Spectacular 360-degree views over Alsace plain, Black Forest (Germany), and Alps on clear days. The WWI memorial Hartmannswillerkopf is nearby. The Chalet-Hotel du Grand Ballon at the top has a restaurant/cafe. Taxi from Gerardmer approx. 40min (no direct public transport to trailhead). Arrive by afternoon after morning train from Paris.
attractions.notes_local: Plus haut sommet des Vosges (1 424m). Boucle depuis le parking du Grand Ballon. En mai, possibilité de neige résiduelle au sommet. Vent fort possible. Vue panoramique sur la plaine d'Alsace, la Forêt-Noire et les Alpes. Chalet-Hôtel du Grand Ballon au sommet (restauration). Taxi depuis Gérardmer ~40min.

attractions.notes_base: The main lake in Gerardmer town, nicknamed 'Pearl of the Vosges'. 4km circumference walk around the lake is easy and flat — perfect for evening after arriving from Paris and before the afternoon hike, or post-hike relaxation. Lovely mountain reflections. Pedal boats and canoes available seasonally (usually mid-May onward, may not yet be operating May 1). Free to walk around. Restaurants and cafes along the lakefront. Walk takes ~45-60 minutes at leisure.
attractions.notes_local: Lac principal de Gérardmer, surnommé 'Perle des Vosges'. Tour du lac 4km, facile et plat. Idéal en soirée après l'arrivée de Paris. Bateaux à pédales et canoës en saison (généralement mi-mai). Restaurants et cafés en bordure du lac.

attractions.location_base: Parking Sentier des Roches, D430, 68140 Stosswihr, Alsace (near Le Valtin, Frankenthal-Missheimle nature reserve)
attractions.location_local: Parking Sentier des Roches, D430, 68140 Stosswihr
attractions.opening_hours: Open year-round; closes in hazardous conditions (check OT Munster before going)
attractions.notes_base: The most famous and spectacular hiking trail in the Vosges, running through the Frankenthal-Missheimle National Nature Reserve. The trail traverses dramatic rocky ridges and sandstone cliffs via metal ladders, chains, and iron rungs fixed into the rock — a via ferrata-style route. SAFETY CRITICAL: Proper hiking boots with ankle support are absolutely mandatory (no trail runners or sneakers). The path can be wet and slippery in early May. Chains and iron staples provide handholds on steep sections. The classic loop is 'boucle depuis Le Valtin' passing through the reserve. Total loop ~8-12km depending on variant, 3-4 hours. The reserve protects rare flora including Alpine plants. Trailhead parking: use the Parking Sentier des Roches off D430 road between Stosswihr and Le Valtin (48.0598, 7.0254). Shuttle/taxi from Gerardmer via Xonrupt-Longemer ~30min. Do NOT attempt in rain or after heavy rain — rocks become dangerously slippery. Trail is unidirectional in busy season (follow signs). Rated GR533 connection.
attractions.notes_local: Sentier le plus célèbre et spectaculaire des Vosges. Traverse la Réserve naturelle nationale de Frankenthal-Missheimle. Echelles, chaînes et échelons métalliques fixés dans le rocher. OBLIGATOIRE : chaussures de randonnée montantes avec semelles crantées. Sentier glissant en mai. Boucle depuis Le Valtin ~3-4h. Ne pas emprunter par temps de pluie ou après de fortes pluies. Vérifier l'accès auprès de l'OT de Munster.

attractions.notes_base: Third highest peak in the Vosges at 1,363m. Impressive glacial cirques (cwms) with dramatic cliff walls. The Wormspel Combe loop from Hohneck is 7.09km, easy-moderate difficulty. Stunning views of the glacially-carved landscape. In early May, may have snow patches on north-facing slopes. The Chalet-Hotel du Hohneck at the summit has refreshments. Accessible from the Sentier des Roches area — good option IF energy remains after the Sentier des Roches hike. Parking available at Hohneck summit area (accessible by car via Route des Cretes D430). Only attempt if you finish Sentier des Roches before 2pm and still have energy.
attractions.notes_local: Troisième sommet des Vosges (1 363m). Cirques glaciaires spectaculaires. Boucle Combe du Wormspel depuis le Hohneck 7,09km, facile-modéré. Possible en option si énergie suffisante après le Sentier des Roches (avant 14h). Chalet-Hôtel du Hohneck au sommet.

attractions.name_base: Tour des Trois Lacs (Three Lakes Circuit)
attractions.location_base: Starting from Orbey village or Lac Blanc parking, 68370 Orbey, Alsace
attractions.opening_hours: Open year-round (daylight hours); note train back to Paris — plan return time carefully
attractions.notes_base: Classic circular hike linking three beautiful high-altitude glacial lakes: Lac Blanc (alt. ~1,054m), Lac Noir (alt. ~954m), and Lac des Truites (alt. ~897m). Loop from Orbey: 13.6km, ~4h36 hiking time, 460m elevation gain, Moderate. Start early (7:30-8:00am) to finish in time for return to Paris. Trailhead: Orbey village or take the road to Lac Blanc parking (48.1252, 7.0962) and join the circuit from there. The Lac Blanc parking is the most popular starting point and shortens the approach. Trail follows GR5 and local waymarked paths. In early May, some sections near the lake shores may be muddy. The three lakes have distinct characters: Lac Blanc is the most dramatic with chalet station, Lac Noir is more secluded with wild feel, Lac des Truites is peaceful. FISHING: A fishing permit (carte de peche journaliere) is required in France — purchase at local fishing tackle shops in Gerardmer or Orbey town, or via the Fedepêche 68 website (~15 EUR/day). Best fishing spots: Lac des Truites or Lac Noir banks. Trout (truite) is the main species. Finish hike and return to Gerardmer for train back to Paris (check SNCF connection via Remiremont or Epinal).
attractions.notes_local: Boucle reliant trois lacs glaciaires: Lac Blanc, Lac Noir, Lac des Truites. 13,6km, ~4h36, 460m dénivelé, Modéré. Départ depuis Orbey ou parking du Lac Blanc. Partir tôt (7h30-8h) pour rentrer à Paris. PÊCHE: Carte de pêche journalière obligatoire (~15€) à acheter en magasin de pêche à Gérardmer ou Orbey, ou sur fedepêche68.fr. Principale espèce: truite. Meilleurs spots: Lac des Truites ou Lac Noir.

attractions.notes_base: The most dramatic of the three lakes, at 1,054m altitude. Surrounded by rocky crests and small ski station infrastructure. The Auberge du Lac Blanc is located here and may be open in May for refreshments. The lake is part of the Tour des Trois Lacs circuit. Stunning turquoise-green water against rocky ridges. Popular photography spot.
attractions.notes_local: Le plus spectaculaire des trois lacs, à 1 054m d'altitude. Eau turquoise dans un cadre rocheux. Auberge du Lac Blanc potentiellement ouverte en mai. Inclus dans le Tour des Trois Lacs.

attractions.notes_base: Dark, moody glacial lake at 954m altitude. Less frequented than Lac Blanc, with wild, forested shores. Good fishing spot for trout (truite). The lake gets its name from the dark reflection of the surrounding fir forests. Part of the Tour des Trois Lacs circuit.
attractions.notes_local: Lac glaciaire sombre et sauvage à 954m. Moins fréquenté que Lac Blanc. Bon spot de pêche à la truite. Partie du Tour des Trois Lacs.
